blocks.text: Electron microscope electrons ki wave wali fitrat istemal karta hai. Tez electrons ki de Broglie wavelength nazar aane wali roshni ki wavelength se hazaron guna chhoti hoti hai. Isi liye electron microscope woh bareek tafseelat (fine details) dekh leta hai jo optical microscope nahi dekh sakta. Source se nikle electrons ek electromagnetic lens se guzarte hain jise condenser kehte hain; yeh beam ko specimen (namoone) par focus karta hai. Beam ko kai megavolts ke voltage se tez kiya jata hai. Electrons ki speed jitni zyada, wavelength utni chhoti aur resolution (bareek cheezein alag alag dikhane ki salahiyat) utni zyada. Ek electromagnetic lens (objective lens) specimen ki image banata hai. Electromagnetic projector lens is image ko mazeed bara karta hai aur film par is ki tasveer li jati hai, jise micrograph kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Dashed mehwar wala amudi column. Electron source ke electrons magnetic condenser se guzar kar specimen par jama hote hain; magnetic objective pehli tasveer (first image) banata aur electromagnet image projector neeche doosri bari tasveer (second magnified image) banata hai.

blocks.long_description: Yeh roshni ke projector ki tarah kaam karta hai, lekin sheeshe ke lenses ki jagah magnetic lenses electrons ki shua morte hain. Electron ki wavelength bohat chhoti hone se kaheen chhoti tafseelat nazar aati hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yeh bilkul roshni wale microscope jaisa hai, farq yeh hai ke sheeshe ke lenses ki jagah magnetic lenses electrons ki beam ko modte aur focus karte hain, aur roshni ki jagah electrons ki bohat chhoti wavelength kaam aati hai.
Jadeed (modern) qisam, jise scanning electron microscope kehte hain, behtareen quality ki teen-dimensional (3D) image de sakti hai.

Electron microscope nano-metre tak, yani taqreeban atoms ki satah tak, bohat chhoti tafseelat dekh sakta hai. Is ke istemal: microbiology mein cell ki banawat, viruses aur bacteria ka mutala; metals mein daraaron (fractures) ki jaanch; aur materials aur crystals ki banawat ka mutala.

blocks.explanation: Resolution istemal hone wali wavelength par depend karti hai. Tez electrons ki de Broglie wavelength nazar aane wali roshni se hazaron guna chhoti hai, is liye kahin chhoti cheezein alag alag dekhi ja sakti hain.

items: Electron microscope electrons ki bohat chhoti de Broglie wavelength istemal karta hai.
Condenser, objective aur projector teeno electromagnetic lenses hain; tasveer micrograph kehlati hai.
Zyada voltage: zyada speed, chhoti wavelength, behtar resolution; scanning electron microscope 3D image deta hai.
